messages.content: Do you think consciousness is an illusion?

It's one of philosophy's deepest open questions. Hard physicalists argue consciousness is entirely reducible to brain states, while dualists and proponents of panpsychism see it as something more fundamental. I find the 'hard problem' — why there is subjective experience at all — genuinely compelling and unresolved.
